reviews.text: me encantan estas mascarillas! son mis favoritas para mí piel que es grasa. Me ayuda a hidratar cuando siento mi piel un poco deshidratada y a difuminar la apariencia de los poros, 10/10.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢啲面膜！係我油性皮膚嘅最愛。當我覺得皮膚有少少缺水嗰陣，佢幫我補濕，又令毛孔睇落冇咁明顯，10/10。

reviews.text: Not sure if I noticed any difference to the pores across my nose, but I have only tried one of the masks so far. However, it did leave my skin feeling very refreshed, glowing and hydrated
reviews.zh: 唔確定鼻位嘅毛孔有冇改善，因為我到目前為止只試過一片面膜。不過，用完皮膚感覺好清爽、有光澤，亦都補足咗水分。

reviews.text: If you’re one of those people that likes to feel a mask tingle because it makes it feel like it’s working better, these are the masks for you. They’re super tingly and refreshing. just get them.
reviews.zh: 如果你係嗰種鍾意面膜有刺麻感、覺得咁樣先代表有效果嘅人，呢啲面膜就啱你。佢哋刺麻感好強，又好清涼。快啲買啦。

reviews.text: I really liked this mask! There’s plenty of essence and it leaves my skin feeling super soft, smooth and hydrated. I did notice a slight tingling while wearing it, but nothing too uncomfortable for me. My skin looked more fresh and glowy afterwards, and the texture felt noticeably smoother. I’ll definitely use these again.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款面膜！精華好充足，用完皮膚感覺超級柔軟、順滑、水潤。敷嗰陣有少少刺麻感，但對我嚟講唔會太唔舒服。用完之後皮膚睇落更清新、有光澤，質地亦明顯順滑咗。我一定會再用。

reviews.text: Compré este producto por recomendación y por los buenos comentarios que tiene en la comunidad de skincare. A primera vista la textura y el diseño se ven increíbles. Apenas termine las cositas que estoy usando ahora lo voy a probar para contarles mi experiencia detallada, pero promete un montón.
reviews.zh: 我係因為有人推薦，同埋喺護膚社群入面有好多好評先買呢款產品。第一眼睇落，質地同設計都好靚。等我用完而家正用緊嘅產品，就會試吓，同大家詳細講我嘅體驗，睇落好有潛力。

reviews.text: Esta essence me ha gustado muchísimo 😭 siento la piel más lisa, como más “pulida”, y los poros se ven más controlados con el uso constante. No es pesada, se absorbe súper rápido y deja un glow muy bonito sin ser grasoso
reviews.zh: 呢款精華我真係好鍾意 😭 用咗之後皮膚感覺更加幼滑，好似被打磨過咁，而且經常使用之後，毛孔睇落都更加收細。質地唔厚身，吸收超快，會留下好靚嘅光澤，但唔會油膩。

reviews.text: These sheet masks are amazing for refreshing and calming my skin after a long day. My pores looked cleaner and my skin felt smoother after each use. The essence isn’t sticky, and it leaves my skin looking fresh and radiant. Definitely repurchasing
reviews.zh: 呢啲面膜幫我喺漫長一日之後令皮膚清爽、舒緩，效果好正。每次用完，毛孔睇落更乾淨，皮膚摸落都更滑。精華唔黏，用完皮膚睇落清新、有光澤。一定會再買。

reviews.text: I saw many videos on Tik Tok that recommended this mask . It is the best mask from this company. Number 3 mask and the torriden one are the most hyped in Korea. Also the abib masks. I hope to see fast the results.
reviews.zh: 我喺 TikTok 見到好多影片推薦呢款面膜。佢係呢個品牌最好嘅面膜。3 號面膜同 torriden 嗰款係韓國最多人炒嘅。仲有 abib 嘅面膜。希望好快見到效果。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
